title: Raukopf House, 240 South Third Street, Richmond, Wayne County, IN
notes: Significance: The Raukopf house is one example of Richmond's mid-nineteenth century middle-income housing.  Styled according to the general outlines of Greek Revival architecture, the design of these structures conforms with the needs of a lower income family.
